title: semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales
abstract: arXiv:2610.37494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The items of a reflective psychometric scale can be read as a proposal about a construct's structure. Language models make that proposal measurable by converting each item into an embedding, a list of numbers, similar for similar meanings. We introduce semanticfa, an R package for semantic factor analysis, which factors item-embedding similarities. It also interprets factors, flags redundant items, builds short forms, and screens new items. A worked example analyzes the 50-item International Personality Item Pool Big-Five Factor Markers, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, and compares the results with a factor analysis of 874,434 respondents. Retention criteria tied between five and six factors, and the tie rule kept five. Three corresponded mainly to single domains, and two blended most Extraversion items with five Agreeableness items. Each factor's congruence with its best-matching human factor (1 = identical) ranged from .92 for Openne

translated_title: semanticfa：用于心理测量量表无响应语义因子分析的R语言包
translated_abstract: 反映性心理测量量表的题目可以被解读为关于某个构念结构的一种提议。语言模型通过将每个题目转换为嵌入向量（即一组数字，含义相近则向量相似）使这一提议变得可测量。我们介绍了semanticfa，一个用于语义因子分析的R语言包，它对题目嵌入相似度进行因子分析。该包还能解释因子含义、标记冗余题目、构建简版量表以及筛查新题目。一个实际案例分析了国际人格题库（IPIP）大五人格因子标记的50个题目（使用Qwen3-Embedding-8B进行嵌入），并将结果与874,434名受访者的传统因子分析进行比较。保留标准在五因子与六因子之间持平，平局规则最终保留了五个因子。其中三个因子主要对应单一领域，另外两个因子则将大多数外向性题目与五个宜人性题目混合在一起。每个因子与其最匹配的人类因子之间的吻合度（1 = 完全相同）从开放性的.92起步（摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: semanticfa是一个R语言包，利用语言模型嵌入对心理测量量表进行无需人工作答的语义因子分析，并能解释因子、检测冗余题目和构建简版量表。
